module_summary: JK-style two-state Moore FSM: a 1-bit state register moves OFF to ON on j and back on k, output high in ON.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: OFF/ON state register, sync reset to OFF, set by j and cleared by k.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Moore output decoded high when FSM is in ON state.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: State register, j/k next-state logic and output decode.
